thread:
frank: follow-up from RFC: we need a concrete field for billing provenance so downstream can decide which value to trust. current ad-hoc keys are messy.
lela: totally. proposal: add billing_provenance enum on envelope: [pre_ingest_hint, enriched, reconciled]. also keep billing_key string. provenance drives which counter to surface.
omar: can we get a quick summary of tradeoffs?
frank: short: pre_ingest_hint = minimal cost at ingest, low latency, may be wrong; enriched = added/overridden by enrichers with confidence; reconciled = authoritative after join job.
tia: metric impact? will reconciled updates cause counter churn we can't afford?
lela: estimated effect: reconciler flips ~2.9% of envelopes in our sample; but those flips account for ~7.5% of token-cost heavy traces. so big impact on dollars if left unaddressed.
frank: UX plan: show "live_estimate" (driven by pre_ingest_hint) and "finalized" (reconciled). label both and timestamp "finalized_at" when reconciler runs. customers used to eventual consistency ok?
omar: need an API contract: queries can opt-in to use finalized numbers within window X (default 24h). Also add header X-obs-finalized-available.
tia: reconciliation cadence options? hourly/daily/continuous?
lela: ops prefers a batched daily job for now (costly joins otherwise). daily run at 03:00 UTC behind feature flag. we can tighten cadence later.
frank: storage cost: adding provenance enum + finalized_at ~ +24 bytes per envelope -> ~0.6% storage. acceptable tradeoff?
omar: finance says <1% is fine compared to billing fixes.
frank: we also need confidence semantics across enrichers. standard: confidence in [0,1] float as string? remember JSON must be string but schema will accept value. let's record semantics: confidence >=0.9 means accept overwrite during enrichment; reconciler only honors enriched overrides if confidence >= 0.9 OR enrichment has explicit external proof.
tia: how do we record who changed billing_key? audit trail required. add audit_records array? that's nested. alternative: add last_change_by and last_change_reason fields (string) and last_change_ts. keeps flat and small.
lela: good call. last_change_by = "enricher:tenant-lookup" or "reconciler:daily". last_change_reason = "confidence=0.93" or "reconciler-join:match".
frank: migration plan: backfill reconciled state for last 7 days using current enriched outputs. run canary on 10% of traffic for 48h, monitor reconciliations_applied and billing_delta_ratio.
omar: monitoring: reconciliations_applied gauge, billing_delta_ratio histogram, envelopes_with_no_provenance counter. Alert if reconciliations_applied > 0.5% per hour spike.
tia: developer ergonomics: expose helper functions in SDK to map span -> envelope.billing_key for quick debugging. frontend can use helper to avoid heavy joins.
lela: config flags: obs.billing_provenance_v1 (bool), obs.reconciler_cadence = "daily", obs.reconciler_confidence_threshold = "0.9". feature-flag rollout.
frank: small code snippet for reconciler decision logic:
```
# reconciler pseudocode
if envelope.provenance == "reconciled": skip
if enriched.billing_key and enriched.confidence >= THRESH: set envelope.billing_key = enriched.billing_key; set provenance = "enriched"; record last_change_*
if reconcilers.joined_key != null and joined_key != envelope.billing_key: set envelope.billing_key = joined_key; set provenance = "reconciled"; record last_change_*
```
om ar: typo (omitted).
omar: minor: we should version the enum since UIs and queries depend on it. add provenance_version = "v1" for now.
tia: ops-bot: reconcile-canary scheduled Monday 03:00 UTC behind flag.
deploy-bot: canary-plan queued (feature flag: obs.billing_provenance_v1).
frank: action items: 1) lela PR to schema + metrics 2) omar PR for reconciler + config 3) tia SDK helper + frontend notice 4) ops run canary and backfill plan. I'll write RFC addendum with these points.
lela: copying notes to the RFC draft now.
omar: I'll prototype reconciler join logic and perf estimate.
tia: will add SDK helpers and a short doc blurb about live vs finalized numbers.
frank: if no objections I'll land schema PR tomorrow.
lela: :+1:
omar: +1
